A motion was made by Mr. Moore, seconded by Mr. Korte, to place Ordinance No. 77-14

entitled, “AN ORDINANCE ESTABLISHING A TEMPORARY SIX (6) MONTH

MORATORIUM ON THE ACCEPTANCE AND PROCESSING OF APPLICATIONS

FOR NEW DATA CENTER DEVELOPMENTS, ACCESSORY POWER

GENERATION FACILITIES INTENDED PRIMARILY TO SERVE DATA CENTERS,

AND RELATED USES WITHIN THE CITY OF UPPER SANDUSKY TO ALLOW FOR

A COMPREHENSIVE REVIEW OF THE CITY'S ZONING REGULATIONS, AND

DECLARING THIS ACT AN EMERGENCY.”, on its first reading by title only. Upon

Roll Call, all members voted Yes; the President declared the motion carried. The Clerk read

Ordinance No. 77-14 for the first time by title only.

A motion was made by Mr. M Moore, seconded by Mrs. Niederkohr, to suspend the rules of the

Municipal Charter calling for separate readings on different days. Upon Roll Call, all

members voted Yes; the President declared the motion carried.

A motion was made by Mr. Walker, seconded by Mr. Moore, to place Ordinance No. 77-14

on its second reading by title only. Upon Roll Call, all members voted Yes; the President

declared the motion carried. The Clerk read Ordinance No. 77-14 for the second time by title

only.

A motion was made by Mr. Moore, seconded by Mr. Korte, for the adoption of Ordinance

No. 77-14. Upon Roll Call, all members voted Yes. The President declared the motion

carried and Ordinance No. 77-14 was duly adopted.
